        BO13a Lemma 5 a), figure 5.1. Let σ s be long, and let the chain morphisms ρ (s+1), σ (s+1), …, ρ (s+1+L), σ (s+1+L) be non-long. If ρ (s+1) factors through neither of two distinct arrows F out of x (s+1) and σ (s+1+L) through neither of two distinct arrows G out of x (s+L+2), we get a cleaving D̃ diagram in P/σ s.
